$comment: Our own CI (eCode). Tests need no model and no GPU. The other platforms are built by .github/workflows/ci.yml.
name: ecode

steps.name: Build llama.cpp and test with inference
steps.run:
export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"
command -v cmake || { echo 'this runner has no cmake' >&2; exit 1; }
export BINDGEN_EXTRA_CLANG_ARGS="-I$(gcc -print-file-name=include)"
cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo test --locked --workspace
